proposal.hypothesis: This isolated rewrite computes sqrtf(T) once per option and reuses the same float for d1 and d2. If the compiler does not already eliminate the repeated call, it may reduce scalar math-library work. The formula and CND coefficients remain unchanged; controller correctness checks across varied inputs and measured time will determine whether it is useful.

retained: In black_scholes_serial, compute sqrtf(T) once into sqrtT and reuse it in both d1 and d2; leave the CND polynomial and all other computation unchanged.
